annotations.title: Option structures, zones and whale prints

description: Requires a QuantGeeks plan; not available without signing in (the call asks the user to sign in) or with a free account (the call says it needs a plan). The multi-leg option structures detected in one symbol's flow for a session (type, strikes, expiration, direction, contracts, notional), the price zones they form (with their label and range), and the largest single-leg whale prints (time in US Eastern, strike, expiration, side, contracts, premium). At most 25 per section, largest first (`detail` 'all' lifts the cap). Give symbol, optional date (default: the newest session with stored data) and kind ('all', 'structures', 'zones' or 'whales'). For node levels use quantgeeks_get_gex_ladder or quantgeeks_get_active_levels.

date.description: Session date, YYYY-MM-DD (US Eastern). Default: the newest session with stored data (an overnight session counts).

detail.description: 'summary' (default): the largest 25 of each section; 'all': every row of each section.
